intent: Teach platform number and departure, airport time advice, fishing-boat return at dusk, both port services, road narrowing near a bridge, street quiet after nine, pavement versus crossing and keep-off instruction.
picturePurpose: Original top-down street picture supports two precise area-identification tasks; four changing models and two exact evidence selections teach number, direction, time, width and scope.

transfer.stem: 换成巴士乘车位、补给船和图书馆，哪组保留了三条信息？
transfer.passage:
三条新信息
我们的巴士从四号乘车位出发。补给船在黎明返回岛上。图书馆十点后变得安静。
词语提示：bay 乘车位；supply boat 补给船；island 岛；library 图书馆。

options.text: Our bus leaves from bay four. Supply boats returned to the island at dawn. The library becomes quiet after ten.
Our bus arrives at bay four. Supply boats returned to the island at dawn. The library becomes quiet after ten.
Our bus leaves from bay fourteen. Supply boats returned to the island at dusk. The library becomes quiet after ten.
Our bus leaves from bay four. Supply boats returned to the island at dawn. The library becomes quiet before ten.

answer.display: Our bus leaves from bay four. Supply boats returned to the island at dawn. The library becomes quiet after ten.

explanation.strategy: 核对编号、进出方向、黎明/黄昏与十点前后。

steps.text: 巴士从四号乘车位出发：leaves from bay four。
steps.reason: arrives at是到达；fourteen是十四，均改变原意。

steps.text: 补给船在黎明返回岛上：returned to the island at dawn。
steps.reason: dawn是黎明，dusk是黄昏；returned to表示返回。

steps.text: 图书馆十点后变安静：becomes quiet after ten。
steps.reason: after是之后，before是之前；不补上午或晚上。

distractors.reason: fourteen和dusk分别把四号、黎明改成十四号、黄昏。

explanation.pitfall: 编号不是数量；出发不是到达；dawn不是dusk；after不是before。

visual.caption: 不补具体日期、上午/晚上、人数或行程时长。
